planet.name: Toulan
planet.summary: Toulan is Virtualsense's planet, sharing Elder Tribute and crossover progression with DSEC-9. Visitors get a few free missions and a NawaCore that gates many missions and the CUHOF instances; born avatars get a longer starter chain.
planet.howToReach: Shared warp to Toulan Space Station (Yamato, 6 PED per schedule for paying passengers, free for qualifying born avatars, estate owners and Toulan citizens; Kronan on request), then the station-to-planet teleporter to the Citadel.
warnings: Desk-checked from public sources only; field verification is pending.
Visitor versus born prompts, current NawaCore options, the Nahar broker floor and coordinates, timers, citizenship requirement and instance costs all need a current check.
Some old creature dailies are marked deactivated in the community list. The monthly event calendar can move.
Waypoint names were set by the research notes; the cited sources show the same coordinates (often labelled 'Waypoint').

activities.title: Travel to Toulan and the Citadel
activities.summary: Take a shared warp to Toulan Space Station, then the station-to-planet teleporter down to the Citadel. Yamato serves Toulan; Kronan stops on request.
steps: Book a Yamato run (6 PED per schedule for paying passengers; free for qualifying born avatars, estate owners and Toulan citizens) or ask Kronan for a request stop.
Store valuable lootables before any personal flight through lootable PvP space.
At Toulan Space Station take the station-to-planet teleporter.
Token links: since 19.2.0 eligible links cost 6 tokens station-to-station and 10 planet-to-planet; check the actual menu before buying tokens.

cost.text: 6 PED per Yamato schedule for paying passengers; free for the eligible groups. Token travel, where available, uses Teleportation Tokens.

currencies.name: Teleportation Token
currencies.note: Only if an eligible token link appears in the menu.

activities.limits: Warps run on scheduled dates that shift around event weekends.

score.rationale: Required first step; cost and timing depend on the warp schedule.

warnings: Whether Toulan has a token link was not confirmed; check the station menu.

activities.title: Ahlan's Wedding Ring
activities.summary: A quick visitor mission at the foot of the Citadel TP stairs. Swim to the marker behind the tower; getting close finds the ring. Hand back for a vehicle.
steps: Take Ahlan's Wedding Ring from Ahlan at the foot of the Citadel TP stairs.
Swim to the ring marker behind the tower; proximity triggers the find.
Return to Ahlan.

score.rationale: Sol's step 2; free vehicle for a few minutes' work.

activities.title: Public storyline (Senan, Rabee)
activities.summary: Visitors start the public storyline with Senan in Al-Nahar City, then Rabee at the Nawa Reactor for the pipe route.
steps: Talk to Senan in Al-Nahar City.
Continue to Rabee at the Nawa Reactor for the pipe route.
Check your eligibility before expecting the born-only offworld pistol and outfit rewards.

score.rationale: Sol's step 2; the main visitor story, rewards for visitors unclear.

warnings: Older retrospective notes mention Salam/Bilal for visitors, but the official born guide restricts its extended starter chain. Verify visitor prompts in game.

activities.title: Born-only starter chain (Salam to Guardian Village)
activities.summary: Toulan- and Monrian-born avatars follow a 20-step chain from Salam through Bilal and Ahlan to Guardian Village for starter tools, weapon and ammo, and clothing.
steps: Start with Salam near the Citadel.
Follow Bilal and Ahlan to Guardian Village using the partner's 20-step guide.
At Nadira, eligible born avatars can skip the Where's My Pants riddle and get the waypoint (25.2.1).
Do the chain solo; mission loot may fail in a team.
rewards: Starter tools, weapon and ammo, and clothing

score.rationale: Sol's step 3; free starter kit, but only for born avatars.

warnings: The born guide notes that mission loot may fail when you are in a team.

activities.title: Get NawaCore MK1
activities.summary: Many Toulan missions need a NawaCore. Visitors ask the NawaCore Agent at the Nahar City gate and choose to hunt 100 TabTab or hand in 10,000 Vibrant Sweat. Toulan-born get MK1 when leaving the start room.
steps: Visitors: talk to the NawaCore Agent at the Nahar City gate.
Choose 100 TabTab kills or 10,000 Vibrant Sweat; compare the sweat's cost with the hunt, and pick the hunt if you already hunt TabTab.
Toulan-born: MK1 is given when you leave the start room.

cost.text: Either ammo for 100 TabTab or 10,000 Vibrant Sweat.

score.rationale: Sol's step 4; gates many missions and the instances.

warnings: Current MK1 choices need a field check.

activities.title: Upgrade NawaCore to MK2 and MK3
activities.summary: For each upgrade bring your current core plus the next core's A-E parts. Parts drop in CUHOF or come from other players. Check which tier your target missions need.
steps: Collect the next core's A-E parts in CUHOF or buy them from players.
Bring the prior core and parts to upgrade to MK2, then repeat for MK3.

cost.text: CUHOF runs or player trades for parts.

score.rationale: Needed for later missions and Citizenship; parts cost time or PED.

activities.title: Toulan Citizenship
activities.summary: Bring MK3 to Haneen at the Citadel info booth. Progress comes from qualifying mobs at the monthly events, usually over several events. Rewards are free Yamato travel eligibility and an outfit.
steps: Bring NawaCore MK3 to Haneen at the Citadel info booth.
Join monthly Toulan events and kill qualifying event mobs.
Per the guide, shared-loot kills outside a formal team also count.

score.rationale: Sol's long goal; saves warp fees later but takes several events.

warnings: Current citizenship requirement and event counter need confirming. The monthly event calendar can move.

activities.title: Start Worship the Elder Gods (Toulan Church)
activities.summary: From the Pit North teleporter go to the Church; hand-ins start at the nearby Shrine. Unlock it early if you already mine or hunt eligible mobs.
steps: Teleport to Pit North.
Walk to the Church and start Worship the Elder Gods.
Find the Shrine nearby for hand-ins.

score.rationale: Sol's step 5; cheap to open and pays tributes for work you already do.

activities.title: Thana mining deposit contract
activities.summary: Thana at the Citadel info desk gives a 50-point deposit contract; a larger 500-point version also exists. Accept before probing.
steps: Accept Thana's contract before you start probing.
Mine 50 points (or 500 for the larger version).
Return to Thana.
rewards: 0.05 PED Mining or Prospecting skill (50-point) or 0.50 PED (500-point)

cooldown.resetNote: 16 h reported in the community daily list; what starts it is pending. The app's timer starts when you mark it done, so mark it at hand-in.

score.rationale: First in Sol's order; small skill reward right at the arrival area.

warnings: Whether both sizes can be accepted at once is unverified.
Timer trigger pending.

activities.title: Najran Mokhat hunt (plus terminal)
activities.summary: Najran at the Jelly Zone teleporter asks for 100 Mokhat. Pair it with the 250-kill terminal assignment when eligible.
steps: Check the exact target and any NawaCore requirement first.
Take Najran's 100 Mokhat mission.
Take the 250-kill terminal assignment if eligible.
Hunt and turn in both.
rewards: Terminal: 0.22 PED BLP Weapon Technology skill

cooldown.resetNote: Listed as hourly in the community daily list; what starts the clock is pending. Mark it at hand-in.

score.rationale: Second in Sol's order; small skill rewards that pair with one hunt.

warnings: The cited daily list places the 250-kill BLP Weapon Technology terminal under Sunjoq, not Mokhat. Check which creature it targets in game.
Exact target and core requirement need checking.

activities.title: Find the Dog Tags (Askari)
activities.summary: Askari, outside Guardian Village's east gate by the healing bubble, asks you to find five Dog Tags.
steps: Take the mission from Askari by the healing bubble outside the east gate.
Find five Dog Tags as directed.
Return to Askari.

cooldown.resetNote: 16 h reported in the community daily list; what starts it is pending. The app's timer starts when you mark it done, so mark it at hand-in.

score.rationale: Third in Sol's order; ammo back for a short task.

warnings: How Dog Tags drop and count, and the timer trigger, are pending.

activities.title: Nadira Wants an Apprentice (crafting)
activities.summary: A crafting daily at Guardian Village. Do the intro and the first blueprint-specific version; later repeats count 1,000 craft attempts. No NawaCore is listed.
steps: Take Nadira Wants an Apprentice at Guardian Village.
Do the intro and the first blueprint-specific version (one player found Aqeeq Texture easier than the Jelly/Hide recipes).
Later repeats: make 1,000 craft attempts.
Check ingredient costs before crafting.

cooldown.resetNote: 20 h reported in the community daily list; trigger not stated. Mark it at hand-in.

score.rationale: Fourth in Sol's order; skill only, and 1,000 attempts cost materials.

activities.title: Mirsal contracts at Nahar Towers
activities.summary: On floor 7 of Nahar Towers a mission offer gives contracts such as 50 Duhol, 50 Khaffash, 50 Thawr, 100 mining points, or crafting 50 Butt Joints (needs MK3). Each pays a Mirsal Token.
steps: Go to Nahar Towers floor 7 and find the active mission broker.
Pick a contract: 50 Duhol, 50 Khaffash, 50 Thawr, 100 mining points, or craft 50 Butt Joints (MK3 needed).
Complete and hand in.
requirementsText: NawaCore MK3 for the Butt Joints crafting contract

cost.text: Ammo, mining or crafting costs depending on contract.

currencies.name: Mirsal Token
currencies.note: 1 per assignment; spent at the Citadel or Nahar Towers trader.

cooldown.resetNote: 16 h per the community daily list; how the clock starts is unconfirmed. Mark it at hand-in.

score.rationale: Fifth in Sol's order; Mirsal Tokens buy blueprints and keys.

warnings: The guide's altitude for the broker differs from its own floor-7 route; navigate by floor and confirm the broker.
Unlock tier for the hunting/mining contracts is unconfirmed.

activities.title: Elder Tribute assignments (Toulan Church/Shrine)
activities.summary: Early Church tasks include Bahri or TabTab hunts; match them to other objectives. Mining, crafting hand-ins and the extra low-level hunt share availability with DSEC-9.
steps: Take available assignments at the Church or Shrine.
Match early Bahri or TabTab hunts with your other hunting objectives.
Remember mining, crafting hand-ins and the low-level hunt are shared with DSEC-9; ordinary hunting in both regions can count in one cycle.
After Initiate, the extra Aqeeq/Nawa mining 'Weekly' assignment opens.
rewards: Usually 1 Elder Tribute per early task; shrapnel on some hand-ins

currencies.name: Elder Tribute
currencies.note: Kept for robe thresholds; see the DSEC-9 file for thresholds.

activities.limits: Some assignments are shared with DSEC-9's Church.

cooldown.resetNote: Base 16 h per the partner guide. The Initiate extra 'Weekly' Aqeeq/Nawa mining assignment now starts a 16 h clock at turn-in (25.2.1). Mark it at hand-in.

score.rationale: Sixth in Sol's order; tributes from work that overlaps other dailies.

warnings: Keep enough tributes for your next robe before buying trader items.

activities.title: CorBite Tasks for Rais
activities.summary: After Negotiate a Trade Deal in the DEC Emissary crossover, Rais in the CorBite office hands out tasks. Finish 50 for 50 Mirsal Tokens.
steps: Finish Negotiate a Trade Deal in the DEC Emissary crossover.
Ask Rais in the CorBite office for a task; ask for a different one if needed.
Each task has an hour; a new one is available 15 min after you complete one.
Complete 50 tasks.
requirementsText: Negotiate a Trade Deal completed in the DEC Emissary crossover

currencies.name: Mirsal Token
currencies.note: 50 for the full set of tasks.

cooldown.resetNote: Partner says it repeats after seven days; what starts the timer is pending. Mark it when you finish.

score.rationale: Last in Sol's order; large token payout but needs the crossover and 50 tasks.

warnings: Current timer trigger pending; source is a 2022 quarterly.

activities.title: Spend Mirsal Tokens
activities.summary: Mirsal Tokens buy from the Citadel or Nahar Towers trader. Partner updates added weapon/tool blueprints and CUHOF Legends key blueprints; Estate Lost Pages are optional.
steps: Choose a specific target item before spending.
Check live stock, transport flags and ingredient costs at the trader.
rewards: Blueprints and CUHOF Legends key blueprints

currencies.name: Mirsal Token
currencies.note: Spent at the Citadel or Nahar Towers trader.

activities.title: CUHOF entry: Nawa Energy Cells and Legends keys
activities.summary: Ordinary CUHOF and Mini runs use Nawa Energy Cells. Each cell is refined from 100 Vibrant Sweat and one Nawa Shard (from two Nawa Fragments). CUHOF Legends uses separate solo or team keys crafted from limited blueprints.
steps: Refine Nawa Energy Cells: 100 Vibrant Sweat plus 1 Nawa Shard (made from 2 Nawa Fragments) per cell.
Check the entry count at the portal.
For CUHOF Legends, craft a solo or team key from its limited blueprint.

cost.text: Vibrant Sweat and Nawa Fragments per cell; key materials for Legends.

score.rationale: Explains how to pay for CUHOF entry before you try it.

warnings: Since 25.1 ordinary CUHOF 1-5 end chests are gone in favor of creature loot; Legends has its own two-part run and chest stage.
Instance costs need a current check.

activities.title: CUHOF gear and armor plate upgrades
activities.summary: Toulan gear grew in steps: Improved Baraka (25.1), Modified Baraka (25.3), component and weapon blueprints (26.1), CUHOF armor plate upgrades II-V (26.3). Since 26.4 (2026-11-11) plates II-V give 0.5%, 1%, 1.5% and 2% block chance.
steps: Ask the CUHOF Caves merchant for current upgrade requirements.
Note the UI may truncate the block-chance percentages.
rewards: Plate block chance 0.5% / 1% / 1.5% / 2% for tiers II-V

cost.text: Upgrade requirements not listed in Sol's notes.

score.rationale: Useful only once you run CUHOF regularly.
